401171301.text: Hey Kaeya, you promised to tell me the story about the Jinni-in-a-bottle if I didn't run off. Remember?

401171302.text: Ah, yes. Alright, where did I leave off...?

401171303.text: Oh, I remember! The Jinni came out, and was going to eat the shepherd boy who opened the bottle.

401171304.text: Right, as the Jinni opened its wide, menacing mouth, the shepherd boy suddenly had an idea.

401171305.text: Did he throw a Jumpy Dumpty into the Jinni's mouth?

401171306.text: Haha, I'm sure that's what he would have done if he had a Jumpy Dumpty.

401171307.text: But the shepherd boy didn't have anything like that.

401171314.text: He said to the Jinni, "Wait, how could your massive body fit inside such a small bottle? I won't ever believe it unless I see with my own eyes!"

401171308.text: The Jinni became angry, and said, "Mwahaha. Foolish boy, you dare question my powers!?"

401171309.text: The Jinni then returned inside the bottle and the boy swiftly sealed it shut.

401171310.text: Yay! That mean Jinni won't ever come out again!

401171311.text: But, can the Jinni sleep inside such a tiny bottle? It's probably not very comfortable...

401171312.text: No, but the Jinni was captured and sealed away in the bottle because it did many bad things.

401171313.text: So the most important thing to remember is, if you do something bad and don't want to get locked up, then don't get caught.

401171401.text: Klee said that they discovered some mysterious tracks that you can ride on using a "super fun Choo-Choo Cart."

401171402.text: Ah, I heard something about that, too. Apparently it's a cart that goes zipping along a "terrifying" course at an "uncontrollable" speed...

401171403.text: Yeah, that should be the one. It seems that when the cart rolls down a steep drop, your body would start floating as if it was weightless.

401171404.text: Really? Huh, I heard that Klee's bag almost flew away on the ride. If Kaeya hadn't managed to quickly catch it, countless Jumpy Dumpties would have been thrown into the air.

401171405.text: Oh no, that sounds pretty dangerous...

401171406.text: *sigh* But, if you really want to go for a ride, I'll accompany you if I have time.

401171407.text: Huh? But Eula, how did you know...

401171408.text: I could tell that you wanted to try it... But let me make this clear, I won't be helping you pick up anything that flies out during the ride. So make sure you take everything out of your pockets beforehand.

401171501.text: Who would have known I'd find myself in such a mess... Ugh, after all that talk with Alice about letting her daughter visit, too...

401171502.text: But, just as the General said... If we can restore the domain, then...

401171601.text: Uh, what was it that I said at the end of our ride in the Choo-Choo Cart? Something about fish in the sky and stars in the water? Oh my...
